jobs.title: Operator (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Feiere gemeinsam mit uns die Schönheit menschlicher Erfahrungen. Gestalte mit Liebe zur Natur für ein glücklicheres, gesünderes Leben von Menschen. Gemeinsam, mit Herzlichkeit und Bescheidenheit, liefern wir Lebensmittelinnovationen, kreieren inspirierende Düfte und entwickeln Lösungen, mit denen Menschen gut aussehen und sich gut fühlen. Bei mehr als 17.000 Beschäftigten weltweit, die gemeinsam Ideen und Ziele erkunden, gibt es viel zu lernen und viele, von denen wir lernen können. Tauche ein in eine abwechslungsreiche, flexible und anregende Umgebung. Begegne Fachleuten mit echten Befugnissen, mit denen du partnerschaftlich zusammenarbeiten, Freunde finden und deine Fähigkeiten erweitern kannst. Jeden Tag prägen deine Energie, deine Kreativität und deine Entschlossenheit unsere Zukunft und beinflussen Milliarden von Menschen positiv. Jeder Teil von dir ist eine Bereicherung für unsere Welt. Wir sind Givaudan. Human by nature.

Wir suchen eine zuverlässige und qualitätsbewusste Persönlichkeit als **Operator**(m/w/d) für unsere **Abteilung Sampling Liquid Compounding** am Standort **Dübendorf**. In dieser abwechslungsreichen Funktion stellst du flüssige und pulverförmige Aromen mit unterschiedlichen Produktionstechnologien her und stellst dabei die Einhaltung von Rezepturen, Produktionsvorschriften sowie Qualitäts- und Food-Safety-Anforderungen sicher.

## Deine Aufgaben:

- Herstellen von flüssigen Aromen sowie Zwischen- und Endprodukten mittels unterschiedlicher Technologien gemäss Rezeptur und Produktionsvorschriften sowie unter Einhaltung der vorgegebenen Zeit, Menge und Qualität
- Herstellen von pulverförmigen Aromen mittels verschiedener Technologien wie Spray Dry, Granulator und Blends
- Sicherstellung der korrekten Lagerhaltung und Buchung von Rohstoffen sowie Zwischen- und Endprodukten
- Konsequente Umsetzung und Einhaltung der Food-Safety-Richtlinien inklusive CCP Punkte
- Auffüllen und Bereitstellen von Rohstoffen
- Aufräumen und Reinigen des Arbeitsbereichs sowie aller verwendeten Anlagen und Geräte
- Aktives und rechtzeitiges Informieren der zuständigen Stellen bei Produktionsabweichungen oder anderen Unregelmässigkeiten

Die Arbeitszeiten sind von Montag bis Freitag im 2-Schichtbetrieb. Die Frühschicht dauert von 06:00 bis 14:00 Uhr, die Spätschicht von 14:00 bis 22:00 Uhr.

## Dein Profil:

- Abgeschlossene Lehre in der Lebensmittelindustrie oder Chemie
- Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; gute Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil
- Erfahrung im Bereich Arbeitshygiene und Food Safety
- Gute EDV-Anwenderkenntnisse
- Sorgfältige, zuverlässige und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise
- Teamorientierte und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit

## Welche zusätzlichen Benefits bieten wir an?

- Interessante Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- 40 Stunden Woche
- Zusätzlich bezahlte Freie Tage
- Vorteilhafte Pensionskassen Konditionen
- Ermässigte Verpflegung im Personalrestaurant
- Sport- und Freizeitaktivitäten im Givaudan Sportclub (Duschen vor Ort)
- Rabatt im Mitarbeitershop in Kemptthal
- Gratis Firmenparkplatz und Bike Badge
- REKA Checks und SBB Halbtax beteiligung
- Weltweite private Unfalldeckung und freie Spitalwahl
- Zusätzliche Freiwillige Familien- und Ausbildungszulagen

Bei Givaudan trägst du dazu bei, köstliche Geschmacks- und Dufterlebnisse zu schaffen, die das Leben der Menschen bereichern. Wir schätzen die unterschiedlichen Perspektiven, die aus vielfältigen Kulturen, Hintergründen und Erfahrungen entstehen. Jede Person – unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung, Kultur, Religion oder persönlichen Lebensumständen – ist bei Givaudan herzlich willkommen, einem Ort, an dem wir alle gerne sind und wachsen.

Jeder Teil von dir ist eine Bereicherung für unsere Welt. Mach mit und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns eine bessere Zukunft.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Festeggia con noi la bellezza delle esperienze umane. Crea con amore per la natura per una vita più felice e più sana delle persone. Insieme, con calore e modestia, forniamo innovazioni alimentari, creiamo profumi ispiranti e sviluppiamo soluzioni che fanno sembrare le persone e si sentono bene. Con più di 17.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo che esplorano insieme idee e obiettivi, c'è molto da imparare e molti da imparare. Immergetevi in un ambiente vario, flessibile e stimolante. Incontra professionisti con poteri reali che è possibile partner con, fare amici, e espandere le vostre abilità. Ogni giorno, la vostra energia, creatività e determinazione plasmano il nostro futuro e influiscono positivamente miliardi di persone. Ogni parte di voi è un arricchimento per il nostro mondo. Siamo Givaudan. Umano per natura.

Siamo alla ricerca di una personalità affidabile e di qualità-cosciente come **Operatore**(m/f/d) per il nostro **Sampling Liquid Compounding** dipartimento presso il nostro sito **Dübendorf**. In questa variegata funzione, si producono aromi liquidi e polverosi con diverse tecnologie di produzione, garantendo il rispetto di ricette, regolamenti di produzione e requisiti di qualità e sicurezza alimentare.

## I vostri compiti:

- Produzione di aromi liquidi e prodotti intermedi e finali per mezzo di diverse tecnologie in base alle normative di ricetta e produzione e nel rispetto del tempo, della quantità e della qualità
- Produzione di aromi in polvere utilizzando varie tecnologie come spray secco, granulatore e miscele
- Garantire una corretta conservazione e prenotazione di materie prime e prodotti intermedi e finali
- Coerente implementazione e conformità alle linee guida per la sicurezza alimentare, inclusi i punti PCC
- Riempimento e fornitura di materie prime
- Pulizia e pulizia della zona di lavoro e tutte le attrezzature utilizzate
- Informazioni attive e tempestive agli organi competenti in caso di deviazioni di produzione o altre irregolaritÃ

Gli orari di lavoro sono da lunedì a venerdì in 2 turni. Il primo turno dura dalle 06:00 alle 14:00, il passaggio tardivo dalle 14:00 alle 22:00.

## Il tuo profilo:

- Formazione completa nell'industria alimentare o chimica
- Buona conoscenza del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura; Buone abilità inglesi sono utili
- Esperienza nell'igiene del lavoro e nella sicurezza alimentare
- Buona conoscenza dell'utente del computer
- Metodo di lavoro attento, affidabile e di qualità
- Personalità orientata al team e responsabile

## Quali vantaggi aggiuntivi offriamo?

- Opportunità di sviluppo e formazione interessanti
- 40 ore settimanali
- Ulteriori giorni pagati
- Condizioni di fondo pensione vantaggiose
- Cibo ridotto nel ristorante del personale
- Attività sportive e ricreative presso il Givaudan Sports Club (docce in loco)
- Sconto nel negozio di dipendenti a Kemptthal
- Gratis Azienda Parcheggio e Bike Badge
- REKA Controllo e partecipazione delle FFS Halbtax
- Copertura degli incidenti privati in tutto il mondo e scelta gratuita dell'ospedale
- Prestazioni complementari per la famiglia e l'istruzione

A Givaudan, aiuta a creare deliziosi sapori e fragranze esperienze che arricchiscono la vita delle persone. Apprezziamo le diverse prospettive che emergono da diverse culture, sfondi ed esperienze. Ogni persona – indipendentemente dall'etnia, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale, dall'età, dalla disabilità, dalla cultura, dalla religione o dalle circostanze personali – è il benvenuto a Givaudan, un luogo dove tutti noi apprezziamo essere e crescere.

Ogni parte di voi è un arricchimento per il nostro mondo. Unisciti a noi e costruisci un futuro migliore insieme a noi.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Celebrate with us the beauty of human experiences. Create with love for nature for a happier, healthier life of people. Together, with warmth and modesty, we deliver food innovations, create inspiring fragrances and develop solutions that make people look and feel good. With more than 17,000 employees worldwide exploring ideas and goals together, there is much to learn and many to learn from. Immerse yourself in a varied, flexible and stimulating environment. Meet professionals with real powers that you can partner with, make friends, and expand your skills. Every day, your energy, creativity and determination shape our future and positively impact billions of people. Every part of you is an enrichment to our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

We are looking for a reliable and quality-conscious personality as **Operator**(m/f/d) for our **Sampling Liquid Compounding** department at our **Dübendorf** site. In this varied function, you produce liquid and powdery aromas with different production technologies, ensuring compliance with recipes, production regulations and quality and food safety requirements.

## Your tasks:

- Production of liquid flavours as well as intermediate and final products by means of different technologies according to recipe and production regulations and in compliance with the given time, quantity and quality
- Production of powdered flavors using various technologies such as spray dry, granulator and blends
- Ensuring correct storage and booking of raw materials and intermediate and final products
- Consistent implementation and compliance with food safety guidelines, including CCP points
- Filling and provision of raw materials
- Cleaning and cleaning the work area and all equipment used
- Active and timely information to the competent bodies in the event of production deviations or other irregularities

Working hours are from Monday to Friday in 2-shift operation. The early shift lasts from 06:00 to 14:00, the late shift from 14:00 to 22:00.

## Your profile:

- Completed teaching in the food industry or chemistry
- Good knowledge of German in words and writing; Good English skills are beneficial
- Experience in occupational hygiene and food safety
- Good computer user knowledge
- Careful, reliable and quality-conscious work method
- Team-oriented and responsible personality

## What additional benefits do we offer?

- Interesting development and training opportunities
- 40 hours per week
- Additional paid free days
- Advantageous Pension Fund Conditions
- Reduced food in the staff restaurant
- Sports and leisure activities at the Givaudan Sports Club (on-site showers)
- Discount in the employee shop in Kemptthal
- Free Company Parking and Bike Badge
- REKA Checks and SBB Halbtax participation
- Worldwide private accident coverage and free hospital choice
- Additional voluntary family and education allowances

At Givaudan, you help create delicious taste and fragrance experiences that enrich people’s lives. We value the different perspectives that emerge from diverse cultures, backgrounds and experiences. Every person – regardless of ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion or personal circumstances – is welcome at Givaudan, a place where we all enjoy being and growing.

Every part of you is an enrichment to our world. Join us and build a better future together with us.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Célébrez avec nous la beauté des expériences humaines. Créer avec amour pour la nature pour une vie plus heureuse et plus saine des gens. Ensemble, avec chaleur et modestie, nous livrons des innovations alimentaires, créons des parfums inspirants et développons des solutions qui font que les gens regardent et se sentent bien. Avec plus de 17 000 employés dans le monde qui explorent ensemble des idées et des objectifs, il y a beaucoup à apprendre et beaucoup à apprendre. Plongez-vous dans un environnement varié, flexible et stimulant. Rencontrez des professionnels avec de vrais pouvoirs avec lesquels vous pouvez vous associer, vous faire des amis et développer vos compétences. Chaque jour, votre énergie, votre créativité et votre détermination façonnent notre avenir et affectent positivement des milliards de personnes. Chaque partie de vous est un enrichissement pour notre monde. Nous sommes Givaudan. De nature humaine.

Nous recherchons une personnalité fiable et soucieuse de la qualité comme **Operator**(h/f/d) pour notre département **Sampling Liquide Compounding** sur notre site **Dübendorf**. Dans cette fonction variée, vous produisez des arômes liquides et poudreux avec différentes technologies de production, assurant le respect des recettes, des règlements de production et des exigences de qualité et de sécurité alimentaire.

## Vos tâches:

- Production d'arômes liquides ainsi que de produits intermédiaires et finals au moyen de différentes technologies selon les règles de recette et de production et dans le respect du temps, de la quantité et de la qualité
- Production d'arômes en poudre à l'aide de diverses technologies telles que les vaporisateurs secs, granulateurs et mélanges
- Assurer un stockage et une réservation corrects des matières premières et des produits intermédiaires et finaux
- Mise en oeuvre et respect cohérents des lignes directrices sur la salubrité des aliments, y compris les points CCP
- Remplissage et fourniture de matières premières
- Nettoyage et nettoyage de la zone de travail et de tout l'équipement utilisé
- Informations actives et en temps utile aux organismes compétents en cas d'écarts de production ou d'autres irrégularités

Les heures de travail sont du lundi au vendredi en 2 équipes. Le premier quart dure de 6 h à 14 h, le dernier quart de 14 h à 22 h.

## Votre profil:

- Achevé l'enseignement dans l'industrie alimentaire ou la chimie
- Bonne connaissance de l'allemand en mots et en écriture; Bonnes compétences en anglais sont bénéfiques
- Expérience en hygiène du travail et sécurité alimentaire
- Bonne connaissance de l'utilisateur d'ordinateur
- Méthode de travail prudente, fiable et soucieuse de la qualité
- Personnalité axée sur l'équipe et responsable

## Quels avantages supplémentaires offrons-nous?

- Possibilités de perfectionnement et de formation intéressantes
- 40 heures par semaine
- Jours supplémentaires gratuits payés
- Conditions avantageuses pour la Caisse de retraite
- Restauration réduite dans le restaurant du personnel
- Activités sportives et de loisirs au Givaudan Sports Club (douches sur place)
- Réduction dans la boutique des employés à Kemptthal
- Stationnement de l'entreprise gratuit et insigne de vélo
- REKA Checks et participation CFF Halbtax
- Couverture mondiale des accidents privés et libre choix des hôpitaux
- Allocations familiales et éducatives supplémentaires volontaires

Chez Givaudan, vous aidez à créer de délicieuses expériences de goût et de parfum qui enrichissent la vie des gens. Nous apprécions les différentes perspectives qui émergent de diverses cultures, milieux et expériences. Toute personne – indépendamment de son appartenance ethnique, de son identité de genre, de son orientation sexuelle, de son âge, de son handicap, de sa culture, de sa religion ou de sa situation personnelle – est la bienvenue à Givaudan, un endroit où nous aimons tous être et grandir.

Chaque partie de vous est un enrichissement pour notre monde. Rejoignez-nous et construisez un avenir meilleur avec nous.

jobs.title: Global OT Stream Lead
jobs.description:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness and humility, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions that make people look and feel good. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Dive into varied, flexible, and stimulating environments. Meet empowered professionals to partner with, befriend, and stretch your skills alongside. Every day, your energy, your creativity, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

## Global OT Stream Lead - Your future role?

As the Global OT Stream Lead, you will play a critical role in driving the strategy, implementation, and maintenance of OT systems across the organization. You will ensure alignment with global business objectives, supports digital transformation initiatives, and maintains secure, reliable, and efficient OT environments. You will liaise with Operations, EHS, Quality, IM&S, ManEx & IT to align programs and projects for improving technical know how and knowledge in Givaudan. By leading a global team of Regional OT Managers and supporting local OT Champions, you will foster collaboration, standardization, and innovation across all operational sites.

In this role you will report directly to the Head of CoE.

Multiple location: Caronno Pertusella (Italy), Vernier (Switzerland), Avignon (France), Makó (Hungary), Ashford (UK), Naarden (Netherlands)

## Your main responsibilities will be:

## People management

- Lead and mentor a global team of Regional OT Managers, providing guidance, support, and opportunities for professional growth, while empowering them to enable local OT Champions to drive site-specific initiatives aligned with global standards
- Foster a collaborative environment that bridges the gap between IT and OT teams at the global, regional, and site levels
- Conduct regular performance reviews, set clear objectives, and implement training programs to enhance team competencies

.**Function management**

- Develop and implement a global OT strategy (standardization, security and skills & knowledge) that aligns with organizational goals and ensures the scalability and sustainability of OT systems
- Oversee the management of OT infrastructure, systems, and applications, including SCADA, PLCs, DCS, UNS, MES, and other industrial automation technologies
- Co-own IT/OT initiatives by standardizing software (architecture, deployment, training, compliance, lifecycle management), enabling cybersecurity by design, and supporting key program adoption (UNS, MES, IT/OT)
- Develop OT Vision and convert it into programs/projects to achieve company goals
- Establish and enforce global OT standards, policies, and best practices across all regions and sites
- Ensure compliance with regulatory, cybersecurity, and operational safety requirements for standardized OT systems
- Collaborate with engineering, and operations teams to align OT initiatives with enterprise-wide goals
- Drive innovation by evaluating emerging technologies and incorporating them into the global OT roadmap
- Ensure transfer of best practices from local organization and embed them into standards
- Provide support to project teams at each phase of projects involving process engineering, whether in the context of a site upgrade or new factory, i.e. during design, trial, commissioning and start up phases
- Ability to create and maintain a network of experts within Givaudan
- Responsible for content development for training and startup of new equipment where applicable

## Your professional profile includes:

- Bachelor's degree / MSc in Computer Science, Automation, or a related field
- Fluent in English
- Minimum of 10+ years of experience in Operational Technology, Industrial Automation, or related fields such as Manufacturing, Energy, Utilities, or Process Industries
- Proven track record of leading and managing geographically dispersed teams, including Regional OT Managers and other senior-level technical professionals
- Experience working in a multinational organization with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams
- In-depth knowledge of OT systems, including SCADA, MES, PLCs, DCS, HMI, and related industrial automation technologies.
- Strong understanding of IT/OT convergence and associated challenges, such as network integration and data sharing.
- Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks and standards applicable to OT environments (e.g., IEC 62443, NIST).
- Experience with cloud computing, IoT, and Industry 4.0 technologies.
- Proficiency in project management methodologies

## Our benefits:

- Attractive package with benefits
- Excellent opportunities for progressive learning and development
- A creative team environment that will inspire you
- Other local benefits based on where you are based

At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.

We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.

Everyone — regardless of race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion, or any personal circumstances — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we all love to be and grow.

Every essence of you enriches our world. Join us in making a difference together.

Insieme, con gentilezza e umiltà, forniamo innovazioni alimentari, artigianato fragranze ispirate e sviluppiamo soluzioni di bellezza e benessere che fanno sembrare le persone e sentirsi bene. C'è molto da imparare e molti da imparare, con più di 17.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo per esplorare idee e ambizioni con. Immergiti in ambienti diversi, flessibili e stimolanti. Incontra professionisti abilitati a collaborare con, fare amicizia, e allungare le tue abilità insieme. Ogni giorno, la vostra energia, la vostra creatività e la vostra determinazione plasmano il nostro futuro, facendo una differenza positiva su miliardi di persone. Ogni essenza di voi arricchisce il nostro mondo. Siamo Givaudan. Umano per natura.

## Global OT Stream Lead - Il tuo ruolo futuro?

Come Global OT Stream Lead, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel guidare la strategia, l'implementazione e la manutenzione dei sistemi OT in tutta l'organizzazione. Potrai garantire l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali globali, supporta le iniziative di trasformazione digitale e mantiene ambienti OT sicuri, affidabili ed efficienti. Ti unirai a Operazioni, EHS, Qualità, IM&S, ManEx & IT per allineare programmi e progetti per migliorare la conoscenza e la conoscenza tecnica in Givaudan. Guidando un team globale di Regional OT Managers e supportando i campioni locali di OT, promuoverai collaborazione, standardizzazione e innovazione in tutti i siti operativi.

In questo ruolo si riferirà direttamente al Capo del CdA.

Posizione multipla: Caronno Pertusella (Italia), Vernier (Svizzera), Avignone (Francia), Makó (Ungheria), Ashford (UK), Naarden (Paesi Bassi)

## Le vostre principali responsabilità saranno:

## Gestione delle persone

- Leader e mentore di un team globale di Regional OT Managers, fornendo guida, supporto e opportunità di crescita professionale, consentendo loro di consentire ai campioni locali di OT di guidare iniziative site-specific allineate agli standard globali
- Promuovere un ambiente collaborativo che colmi il divario tra i team IT e OT a livello globale, regionale e sito
- Condurre regolari recensioni delle prestazioni, impostare obiettivi chiari e implementare programmi di formazione per migliorare le competenze del team

.Funzione gestione *

- Sviluppare e implementare una strategia globale OT (standardizzazione, sicurezza e competenze e conoscenze) che si allinea agli obiettivi organizzativi e garantisce la scalabilità e la sostenibilità dei sistemi OT
- Superare la gestione di infrastrutture, sistemi e applicazioni OT, tra cui SCADA, PLC, DCS, UNS, MES e altre tecnologie di automazione industriale
- Co-op iniziative IT/OT standardizzando software (architettura, distribuzione, formazione, conformità, gestione del ciclo di vita), consentendo la sicurezza informatica dal design e supportando l'adozione del programma chiave (UNS, MES, IT/OT)
- Sviluppare OT Vision e convertirlo in programmi/progetti per raggiungere gli obiettivi aziendali

## Global OT Stream Lead - Your future role?

.**Function management**

- Co-own IT/OT initiatives by standardizing software (architecture, deployment, training, compliance, lifecycle management), enabling cybersecurity by design, and supporting key program adoption (UNS, MES, IT/OT)

- Establish and enforce global OT standards, policies, and best practices across all regions and sites
- Ensure compliance with regulatory, cybersecurity, and operational safety requirements for standardized OT systems
- Collaborate with engineering, and operations teams to align OT initiatives with enterprise-wide goals
- Drive innovation by evaluating emerging technologies and incorporating them into the global OT roadmap
- Ensure transfer of best practices from local organization and embed them into standards
- Provide support to project teams at each phase of projects involving process engineering, whether in the context of a site upgrade or new factory, i.e. during design, trial, commissioning and start up phases

- Responsible for content development for training and startup of new equipment where applicable

## Your professional profile includes:

- Bachelor's degree / MSc in Computer Science, Automation, or a related field
- Fluent in English

Chaque jour, votre énergie, votre créativité et votre détermination façonneront notre avenir, faisant une différence positive sur des milliards de personnes. Chaque essence de vous enrichit notre monde. Nous sommes Givaudan. De nature humaine.

## Global OT Stream Lead - Votre rôle futur?

En tant que responsable du volet OT mondial, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la mise en oeuvre et la maintenance des systèmes OT dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Vous assurerez l'alignement avec les objectifs d'affaires mondiaux, soutiendra les initiatives de transformation numérique et maintiendra des environnements OT sûrs, fiables et efficaces. Vous serez en contact avec Opérations, EHS, Qualité, IM&S, ManEx & IT pour harmoniser les programmes et les projets visant à améliorer les connaissances techniques à Givaudan. En dirigeant une équipe mondiale de gestionnaires régionaux d'OT et en appuyant les champions locaux d'OT, vous favoriserez la collaboration, la normalisation et l'innovation dans tous les sites opérationnels.

Dans ce rôle, vous ferez rapport directement au chef du Conseil de l'Europe.

Emplacement multiple: Caronno Pertusella (Italie), Vernier (Suisse), Avignon (France), Makó (Hongrie), Ashford (Royaume-Uni), Naarden (Pays-Bas)

## Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

## Gestion des personnes

- Diriger et encadrer une équipe mondiale de gestionnaires régionaux de l'OT, en fournissant des conseils, un soutien et des possibilités de croissance professionnelle, tout en leur donnant les moyens de permettre aux champions locaux de l'OT de conduire des initiatives spécifiques au site conformes aux normes mondiales
- Favoriser un environnement de collaboration qui comble le fossé entre les équipes de TI et d'OT aux niveaux mondial, régional et du site
- Effectuer régulièrement des examens du rendement, fixer des objectifs clairs et mettre en oeuvre des programmes de formation pour améliorer les compétences de l'équipe

** Gestion des fonctions**

- Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre une stratégie globale d'OT (normalisation, sécurité, compétences et connaissances) qui s'harmonise avec les objectifs organisationnels et assure l'évolutivité et la durabilité des systèmes d'OT
- Superviser la gestion de l'infrastructure, des systèmes et des applications OT, y compris SCADA, PLC, DCS, UNS, MES et d'autres technologies d'automatisation industrielle
- Copropriété des initiatives TI/OT en standardisant les logiciels (architecture, déploiement, formation, conformité, gestion du cycle de vie), en permettant la cybersécurité par la conception et en appuyant l'adoption de programmes clés (UNS, MES, IT/OT)
- Élaborer une vision de l'OT et la convertir en programmes/projets pour atteindre les objectifs de l'entreprise
- Établir et appliquer des normes, des politiques et des pratiques exemplaires dans toutes les régions et tous les sites
- Assurer la conformité aux exigences réglementaires, de cybersécurité et de sécurité opérationnelle des systèmes OT normalisés
- Collaborer avec les équipes d'ingénierie et d'exploitation pour aligner les initiatives d'OT sur les objectifs de l'ensemble de l'entreprise
- Encourager l'innovation en évaluant les technologies émergentes et en les intégrant dans la feuille de route mondiale de l'OT
- Assurer le transfert des meilleures pratiques des organisations locales et les intégrer dans les normes
- Fournir un soutien aux équipes de projet à chaque phase des projets impliquant l'ingénierie des processus, que ce soit dans le contexte d'une modernisation du site ou d'une nouvelle usine, c'est-à-dire pendant les phases de conception, d'essai, de mise en service et de démarrage
- Capacité de créer et de maintenir un réseau d'experts au sein de Givaudan
- Responsable du développement de contenu pour la formation et le démarrage de nouveaux équipements, le cas échéant

## Votre profil professionnel comprend:

- Baccalauréat / maîtrise en informatique, automatisation ou domaine connexe
- Fluent en anglais
- Au moins 10 ans d'expérience en technologie opérationnelle, en automatisation industrielle ou dans des domaines connexes comme la fabrication, l'énergie, les services publics ou les industries de transformation
- Expérience éprouvée de la direction et de la gestion d'équipes géographiquement dispersées, y compris les gestionnaires régionaux d'OT et d'autres professionnels techniques de haut niveau
- Expérience dans une organisation multinationale avec des équipes interculturelles et interfonctionnelles
- Connaissance approfondie des systèmes OT, y compris SCADA, MES, PLC, DCS, HMI et les technologies d'automatisation industrielle connexes.
- Une bonne compréhension de la convergence IT/OT et des défis connexes, comme l'intégration des réseaux et le partage des données.
- Connaissance des cadres de cybersécurité et des normes applicables aux environnements OT (p. ex. CEI 62443, NIST).
- Expérience des technologies de l'informatique en nuage, de l'IoT et de l'Industrie 4.0.
- Compétence en méthodes de gestion de projets

## Nos avantages :

- Paquet attrayant avec avantages
- Excellentes possibilités d'apprentissage et de développement progressifs
- Un environnement d'équipe créatif qui vous inspirera
- Autres avantages locaux selon l'endroit où vous êtes basé

Chez Givaudan, vous contribuez à de délicieuses expériences de goût et de parfum qui touchent les vies des gens.

Nous apprécions les différentes perspectives qui proviennent de diverses cultures, milieux et expériences.

Chacun, indépendamment de sa race, de son identité de genre, de son orientation sexuelle, de son âge, de son handicap, de sa culture, de sa religion ou de toute autre situation personnelle, est chaleureusement accueilli à Givaudan, un endroit où nous aimons tous être et grandir.

Chaque essence de vous enrichit notre monde. Rejoignez-nous pour faire la différence ensemble.

## Global Process Safety Manager - Your future role?

As the Global Process Safety Manager, you will act as a Subject Matter Expert responsible for developing and implementing policies, processes, and systems specific to process safety management in the production and laboratories of flavors and fragrances business, including technologies such as spray drying, powder blending, extraction, compounding and chemical reactions. Your role will ensure the systematic application of Process Safety Management System, ensuring the implementation of PSM foundational elements such as Commitment to Process Safety, Understand hazards and risks, Manage Risks and Learn from experience, while promoting a robust Process Safety culture across the organization. You will be responsible to support and guide sites Process Safety Experts. Additionally, active participation in cross-functional projects and collaboration with various departments and managing external PSM vendors experts is expected.

You will report directly to the Global Process Safety director. You will be based in Vernier, Switzerland.

## Your main responsibilities will be:

- PSM system leadership: Oversee and reinforce the process safety management system for the F&F business and technologies, ensuring compliance with corporate and, legal safety standards ensuring the implementation of PSM foundational elements Commitment to Process Safety, Understand hazards and risks, Manage Risks and Learn from experience. Managing PSM data, KPIs and Dashboards, ensuring communication on PSM performance
- Risk Assessment Leadership: Lead process risk identification and assessment initiatives in collaboration with Operations, Laboratories engaging various stakeholders across the region & sites, carrying out PSM assessments, plant inspections and audits
- Technical Support & Action Implementation: Support the development, prioritization, and execution of risk assessment actions to address identified Process safety risks
- Training program: Develop and deliver Process Safety Training and awareness programs. Support competency development for EHS, engineers, operations personnel and site leadership. Facilitate communities of practice and technical knowledge sharing
- Operational Partnership: Collaborate with operations to provide guidance and expertise on process safety in a field of control hazards of chemical and compounding processes of operational sites in the Design of the plant, the Integrity of equipment, and the Operation of the facility F&F technologies
- Methodology Development: Implement and enhance risk analysis methodologies, process safety guidance, technical guidelines, and foster a culture of PSM
- Risk Portfolio Management: Ensure global PRA site catalog Governance and risk portfolio calibration related to process safety
- Cultural Improvement: Contribute to enhancing process safety knowledge and culture on-site and beyond, throughout the implementation of Process Safety Management Training and Education
- Cross-Functional Contribution: Actively participate in cross-functional projects for the site
- Managing external process safety consultants

## Your professional profile includes:

- MSc or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering or Chemistry / Organic Chemistry with a minimum of 8 years of experience in Chemical Process Safety
- Proven experience working in a multicultural environment and within a matrix organization, leading PSM in a chemical and compounding production plant, laboratories and R&D chemical plant
- Experience in a field of control hazards of chemical and compounding processes of operational sites in the Design of the plant, the Integrity of equipment, and the Operation of the facility
- Solid knowledge of ATEX, Safety Instrumented Systems
- Certificate in Process Safety Management such as CCPS, NEBOSH PSM is an advantage

- Strong presentation skills for developing and delivering training to elevate knowledge, skills and behaviors at multiple levels of the organization

Ogni giorno, la vostra energia, la vostra creatività e la vostra determinazione plasmano il nostro futuro, facendo una differenza positiva su miliardi di persone. Ogni essenza di voi arricchisce il nostro mondo. Siamo Givaudan. Umano per natura.

## Global Process Safety Manager - Il tuo ruolo futuro?

Come Global Process Safety Manager, si agirà come un esperto di materia principale responsabile per lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di politiche, processi e sistemi specifici per elaborare la gestione della sicurezza nella produzione e laboratori di sapori e fragranze business, tra cui tecnologie come l'essiccazione a spruzzo, miscelazione a polvere, estrazione, composti e reazioni chimiche. Il vostro ruolo garantirà l'applicazione sistematica del sistema di gestione della sicurezza di processo, garantendo l'implementazione di elementi di base PSM come l'impegno a elaborare sicurezza, comprendere rischi e rischi, gestire i rischi e imparare dall'esperienza, promuovendo al contempo una solida cultura di sicurezza di processo in tutta l'organizzazione. Sarete responsabili di supportare e guidare i siti Process Safety Experts. Inoltre, è prevista la partecipazione attiva a progetti interfunzionali e la collaborazione con vari dipartimenti e la gestione di esperti di fornitori PSM esterni.

Ti riferirai direttamente al Global Process Safety Director. Ti troverai a Vernier, in Svizzera.

## Le vostre principali responsabilità saranno:

- Leader del sistema PSM: supervisionare e rafforzare il sistema di gestione della sicurezza di processo per le aziende e le tecnologie F&F, garantendo il rispetto delle norme di sicurezza aziendali e legali che garantiscono l'implementazione di elementi di base PSM Impegno a Process Safety, Capire i pericoli e i rischi, Gestire i rischi e imparare dall'esperienza. Gestione dei dati PSM, KPI e Dashboard, assicurando la comunicazione sulle prestazioni PSM
- Leadership della valutazione del rischio: Iniziative di identificazione e valutazione del rischio del processo di piombo in collaborazione con Operazioni, Laboratori che impegnano vari stakeholders in tutta la regione e siti, effettuando valutazioni di PSM, ispezioni di impianti e audit
- Supporto tecnico & Azione Attuazione: Sostenere lo sviluppo, la priorità e l'esecuzione delle azioni di valutazione del rischio per affrontare i rischi identificati di sicurezza dei processi
- Programma di formazione: Sviluppare e fornire i programmi di formazione e consapevolezza di sicurezza di processo. Sviluppo di competenze di supporto per EHS, ingegneri, personale operativo e leadership del sito. Facilitare comunità di pratica e condivisione di conoscenze tecniche
- Partenariato Operativo: Collabora con le operazioni per fornire indicazioni e competenze sulla sicurezza dei processi in un campo di rischi di controllo dei processi chimici e di compounding dei siti operativi nella progettazione dell'impianto, l'integrità delle apparecchiature e l'operazione delle tecnologie F&F
- Sviluppo della metodologia: implementare e migliorare le metodologie di analisi dei rischi, guida per la sicurezza dei processi, linee guida tecniche e promuovere una cultura del PSM
- Risk Portfolio Management: Garantire il catalogo globale del sito PRA Governance e la calibrazione del portafoglio di rischio relativa alla sicurezza dei processi
- Miglioramento culturale: contribuire a migliorare la conoscenza e la cultura di sicurezza del processo in loco e oltre, durante l'attuazione della Gestione della sicurezza dei processi Formazione e Educazione
- Contributo Cross-Functional: Partecipa attivamente a progetti interfunzionali per il sito
- Gestione di consulenti esterni per la sicurezza dei processi

## Il tuo profilo professionale include:

- MSc o PhD in ingegneria chimica, ingegneria dei processi o chimica / chimica organica con un minimo di 8 anni di esperienza nella sicurezza dei processi chimici
- Esperienza comprovata che lavora in un ambiente multiculturale e all'interno di un'organizzazione di matrice, leader PSM in un impianto di produzione chimico e composto, laboratori e impianti chimici R&D
- Esperienza in un campo di rischi di controllo dei processi chimici e composti di siti operativi nella progettazione dell'impianto, l'integrità delle attrezzature e l'operazione della struttura
- Conoscenza solida di ATEX, Sistemi strumentali di sicurezza
- Certificato nella gestione della sicurezza dei processi come CCPS, NEBOSH PSM è un vantaggio
- Forte capacità comunicative, sia verbali che scritte in lingua locale e inglese
- Forte capacità di presentazione per lo sviluppo e la formazione per elevare conoscenze, competenze e comportamenti a più livelli dell'organizzazione

## I nostri vantaggi:

- Assistenza sanitaria
- Tempo pagato Off e congedo di famiglia
- Piano di pensionamento
- Sport e tempo libero
- Negozio di articoli
- Ristorante personale

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness and humility, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions that make people look and feel good. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Dive into varied, flexible, and stimulating environments. Meet empowered professionals to partner with, befriend, and stretch your skills alongside. Every day, your energy, your creativity, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

## Global Process Safety Manager - Your future role?

As the Global Process Safety Manager, you will act as a Subject Matter Expert responsible for developing and implementing policies, processes, and systems specific to process safety management in the production and laboratories of flavors and fragrances business, including technologies such as spray drying, powder blending, extraction, compounding and chemical reactions. Your role will ensure the systematic application of Process Safety Management System, ensuring the implementation of PSM foundational elements such as Commitment to Process Safety, Understand hazards and risks, Manage Risks and Learn from experience, while promoting a robust Process Safety culture across the organization. You will be responsible to support and guide sites Process Safety Experts. Additionally, active participation in cross-functional projects and collaboration with various departments and managing external PSM vendors experts is expected.

You will report directly to the Global Process Safety director. You will be based in Vernier, Switzerland.

## Your main responsibilities will be:

- PSM system leadership: Oversee and reinforce the process safety management system for the F&F business and technologies, ensuring compliance with corporate and, legal safety standards ensuring the implementation of PSM foundational elements Commitment to Process Safety, Understand hazards and risks, Manage Risks and Learn from experience. Managing PSM data, KPIs and Dashboards, ensuring communication on PSM performance
- Risk Assessment Leadership: Lead process risk identification and assessment initiatives in collaboration with Operations, Laboratories engaging various stakeholders across the region & sites, carrying out PSM assessments, plant inspections and audits
- Technical Support & Action Implementation: Support the development, prioritization, and execution of risk assessment actions to address identified Process safety risks
- Training program: Develop and deliver Process Safety Training and awareness programs. Support competency development for EHS, engineers, operations personnel and site leadership. Facilitate communities of practice and technical knowledge sharing
- Operational Partnership: Collaborate with operations to provide guidance and expertise on process safety in a field of control hazards of chemical and compounding processes of operational sites in the Design of the plant, the Integrity of equipment, and the Operation of the facility F&F technologies
- Methodology Development: Implement and enhance risk analysis methodologies, process safety guidance, technical guidelines, and foster a culture of PSM
- Risk Portfolio Management: Ensure global PRA site catalog Governance and risk portfolio calibration related to process safety
- Cultural Improvement: Contribute to enhancing process safety knowledge and culture on-site and beyond, throughout the implementation of Process Safety Management Training and Education
- Cross-Functional Contribution: Actively participate in cross-functional projects for the site
- Managing external process safety consultants

## Your professional profile includes:

- MSc or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering or Chemistry / Organic Chemistry with a minimum of 8 years of experience in Chemical Process Safety
- Proven experience working in a multicultural environment and within a matrix organization, leading PSM in a chemical and compounding production plant, laboratories and R&D chemical plant
- Experience in a field of control hazards of chemical and compounding processes of operational sites in the Design of the plant, the Integrity of equipment, and the Operation of the facility
- Solid knowledge of ATEX, Safety Instrumented Systems
- Certificate in Process Safety Management such as CCPS, NEBOSH PSM is an advantage
- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written in Local Language and English
- Strong presentation skills for developing and delivering training to elevate knowledge, skills and behaviors at multiple levels of the organization

## Our benefits:

- Healthcare support
- Paid Time Off and family leave
- Retirement plan
- Sport and leisure clubs
- Company shop
- Staff restaurant
- Mobility allowance

At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.

We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.

Everyone — regardless of race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion, or any personal circumstances — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we all love to be and grow.

Every essence of you enriches our world. Join us in making a difference together.

## Global Process Safety Manager - Ihre zukünftige Rolle?

Als Global Process Safety Manager fungieren Sie als Subject Matter Expert, der für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Richtlinien, Prozessen und Systemen verantwortlich ist, die speziell für das Prozesssicherheitsmanagement in der Produktion und in Labors von Aromen und Duftstoffen verantwortlich sind, einschließlich Technologien wie Sprühtrocknen, Pulvermischung, Extraktion, Compoundierung und chemische Reaktionen. Ihre Rolle wird die systematische Anwendung des Prozesssicherheitsmanagementsystems sicherstellen und die Implementierung von grundlegenden PSM-Elementen wie Commitment to Process Safety, Verstehen von Gefahren und Risiken, Risikomanagement und Lernen aus Erfahrungen sicherstellen, während eine robuste Prozesssicherheitskultur im gesamten Unternehmen gefördert wird. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, die Experten für Prozesssicherheit zu unterstützen und zu leiten. Darüber hinaus wird eine aktive Teilnahme an funktionsübergreifenden Projekten und die Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Abteilungen sowie die Verwaltung externer Experten von PSM-Anbietern erwartet.

Sie berichten direkt an den Global Process Safety Director. Sie werden in Vernier, Schweiz, ansässig sein.

## Ihre Hauptaufgaben werden sein:

- PSM-Systemführerschaft: Überwachung und Stärkung des Prozesssicherheitsmanagementsystems für das F & F-Geschäft und die Technologien, Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Unternehmens- und gesetzlichen Sicherheitsstandards, die die Umsetzung der PSM-Grundelemente sicherstellen Verpflichtung zur Prozesssicherheit, Risiko- und Risikoverstehen, Risiken managen und aus Erfahrung lernen. Verwaltung von PSM-Daten, KPIs und Dashboards, Gewährleistung der Kommunikation über die PSM-Leistung
- Führung bei der Risikobeurteilung: Führen Sie Initiativen zur Risikoidentifizierung und -bewertung in Zusammenarbeit mit Operations, Laboratories, die verschiedene Interessengruppen in der Region und an Standorten einbeziehen, Durchführung von PSM-Bewertungen, Werksinspektionen und Audits
- Technische Unterstützung und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen: Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung, Priorisierung und Durchführung von Risikobewertungsmaßnahmen zur Bewältigung identifizierter Prozesssicherheitsrisiken
- Trainingsprogramm: Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von Prozesssicherheitsschulungen und Sensibilisierungsprogrammen. Unterstützung der Kompetenzentwicklung für EHS, Ingenieure, Betriebspersonal und Standortleitung. Erleichterung von Praxisgemeinschaften und technischem Wissensaustausch
- Operationelle Partnerschaft: Zusammenarbeit mit Betrieben, um Beratung und Fachwissen zur Prozesssicherheit in einem Bereich der Kontrollgefahren von chemischen und Compoundierungsprozessen von Betriebsstandorten in der Planung der Anlage, der Integrität der Ausrüstung und dem Betrieb der F & F-Technologien der Anlage bereitzustellen
- Methodikentwicklung: Implementieren und verbessern Sie Risikoanalysemethoden, Prozesssicherheitsleitlinien und technische Richtlinien und fördern Sie eine PSM-Kultur
- Risk Portfolio Management: Sicherstellen eines globalen PRA-Standortkatalogs Governance und Kalibrierung von Risikoportfolios im Zusammenhang mit Prozesssicherheit
- Kulturelle Verbesserung: Beitrag zur Verbesserung des Wissens und der Kultur der Prozesssicherheit vor Ort und darüber hinaus während der gesamten Implementierung von Schulungen und Schulungen zum Prozesssicherheitsmanagement
- Funktionsübergreifender Beitrag: Aktiv an funktionsübergreifenden Projekten für die Site teilnehmen
- Leitung externer Prozesssicherheitsberater

## Ihr berufliches Profil umfasst:

- MSc oder PhD in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering oder Chemie / Organische Chemie mit mindestens 8 Jahren Erfahrung in Chemical Process Safety
- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in einem multikulturellen Umfeld und innerhalb einer Matrixorganisation, Leitung von PSM in einer Chemie- und Compoundieranlage, Labors und F & E-Chemieanlage
- Erfahrung in einem Feld der Kontrolle Gefahren von chemischen und Compoundierungsprozessen der Betriebsstätten in der Planung der Anlage, die Integrität der Ausrüstung und den Betrieb der Anlage
- Solides Wissen über ATEX, Safety Instrumented Systems
- Zertifikat in Process Safety Management wie CCPS, NEBOSH PSM ist von Vorteil
- Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, sowohl verbal als auch in lokaler Sprache und Englisch geschrieben
- Starke Präsentationsfähigkeiten für die Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von Schulungen, um Wissen, Fähigkeiten und Verhaltensweisen auf mehreren Ebenen der Organisation zu verbessern

## Unsere Vorteile:

Rejoignez-nous et célébrez la beauté de l'expérience humaine. Créer pour des vies plus heureuses et plus saines, avec amour pour la nature. Ensemble, avec gentillesse et humilité, nous livrons des innovations alimentaires, des parfums inspirés de l'artisanat et développons des solutions de beauté et de bien-être qui font que les gens regardent et se sentent bien. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre et beaucoup à apprendre, avec plus de 17 000 employés dans le monde pour explorer des idées et des ambitions avec. Plongez dans des environnements variés, flexibles et stimulants. Rencontrez des professionnels habilités à s'associer, à être amis et à étendre vos compétences. Chaque jour, votre énergie, votre créativité et votre détermination façonneront notre avenir, faisant une différence positive sur des milliards de personnes. Chaque essence de vous enrichit notre monde. Nous sommes Givaudan. De nature humaine.

## Global Process Safety Manager - Votre rôle futur?

En tant que responsable de la sécurité des procédés mondiaux, vous agirez en tant qu'expert en matière d'élaboration et de mise en oeuvre de politiques, de processus et de systèmes spécifiques à la gestion de la sécurité des procédés dans la production et les laboratoires de parfums et de parfums, y compris des technologies telles que le séchage par pulvérisation, le mélange de poudre, l'extraction, le composé et les réactions chimiques. Votre rôle permettra d'assurer l'application systématique du Système de gestion de la sécurité des processus, d'assurer la mise en oeuvre d'éléments fondamentaux de la gestion des processus, comme l'engagement à la sécurité des processus, la compréhension des dangers et des risques, la gestion des risques et les leçons tirées de l'expérience, tout en favorisant une solide culture de la sécurité des processus dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Vous serez responsable de soutenir et de guider les sites d'experts en sécurité des processus. De plus, on s'attend à une participation active à des projets interfonctionnels et à une collaboration avec divers ministères et à la gestion d'experts externes des fournisseurs de MSP.

Vous relèverez directement du directeur de la sécurité des processus mondiaux. Vous serez basé à Vernier, Suisse.

## Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

- Leadership du système PSM : Surveiller et renforcer le système de gestion de la sécurité des processus pour les entreprises et les technologies F&F, assurer le respect des normes de sécurité organisationnelles et juridiques assurant la mise en oeuvre des éléments fondamentaux PSM Engagement à traiter la sécurité, comprendre les dangers et les risques, gérer les risques et tirer des leçons de l'expérience. Gestion des données PSM, des KPI et des tableaux de bord, assurant la communication sur les performances PSM
- Leadership en matière d'évaluation des risques : Diriger les initiatives d'identification et d'évaluation des risques du processus en collaboration avec les Opérations, les Laboratoires qui mobilisent divers intervenants de la région et des sites, qui effectuent des évaluations des PSM, des inspections des usines et des vérifications
- Soutien technique et mise en oeuvre des mesures : Appuyer l'élaboration, la hiérarchisation et l'exécution de mesures d'évaluation des risques pour faire face aux risques identifiés pour la sécurité des processus
- Programme de formation : Élaborer et exécuter des programmes de formation et de sensibilisation à la sécurité des processus. Appuyer le perfectionnement des compétences pour l'ESS, les ingénieurs, le personnel opérationnel et la direction du site. Faciliter les communautés de pratique et le partage des connaissances techniques
- Partenariat opérationnel : Collaborer avec les opérations pour fournir des conseils et des compétences sur la sécurité des procédés dans un domaine de contrôle des risques liés aux procédés chimiques et de composition des sites opérationnels dans la conception de l'installation, l'intégrité de l'équipement et l'exploitation des technologies F&F de l'installation
- Élaboration de méthodes : Mettre en œuvre et améliorer les méthodes d'analyse des risques, les directives en matière de sécurité des processus, les directives techniques et favoriser une culture de gestion des risques
- Gestion du portefeuille des risques : Assurer le catalogue mondial des sites d'ERP Gouvernance et étalonnage du portefeuille des risques liés à la sécurité des processus
- Amélioration culturelle : Contribuer à améliorer les connaissances et la culture en matière de sécurité des processus sur place et au-delà, tout au long de la mise en oeuvre de la formation et de l'éducation en matière de gestion de la sécurité des processus
- Contribution interfonctionnelle : Participer activement aux projets interfonctionnels du site
- Gestion des consultants externes en matière de sécurité des procédés

## Votre profil professionnel comprend:

- M.Sc. ou doctorat en génie chimique, génie des procédés ou chimie / chimie organique avec un minimum de 8 ans d'expérience en sécurité des procédés chimiques
- Expérience éprouvée de travail dans un environnement multiculturel et au sein d'une organisation matricielle, dirigeant PSM dans une usine de production de produits chimiques et de composés, des laboratoires et une usine chimique de R-D
- Expérience dans un domaine de contrôle des risques liés aux processus chimiques et de composition des sites opérationnels dans la conception de l'installation, l'intégrité de l'équipement et l'exploitation de l'installation
- Une solide connaissance de l'ATEX, Systèmes Instrumentés de Sécurité
- Certificat en gestion de la sécurité des processus, comme le SPCC, NEBOSH PSM est un avantage
- Fortes compétences en communication verbale et écrite en langue locale et en anglais
- Fortes compétences en présentation pour développer et dispenser une formation visant à élever les connaissances, les compétences et les comportements à plusieurs niveaux de l'organisation

## Nos avantages :

- Soutien aux soins de santé
- Congé payé et congé familial
- Régime de retraite
- Clubs de sport et de loisirs
- Boutique d'entreprise
- Restaurant du personnel

jobs.description:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness and humility, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions that make people look and feel good. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Dive into varied, flexible, and stimulating environments. Meet empowered professionals to partner with, befriend, and stretch your skills alongside. Every day, your energy, your creativity, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

As an **OT Technical Lead (m/w/d)**, you will report directly to our OT & Automation Manager and join our Engineering & Maintenance team in **Vernier (Switzerland)**.

You will ensure the security, reliability, and compliance of Operational Technology (OT) systems across the site. You will design and validate OT architectures, manage cybersecurity risks, and oversee industrial IT infrastructure while ensuring agreement on IT policies and GMP regulations.

## In this exciting role you will :

- OT Architecture & Cybersecurity
  - Design and validate OT network architectures including segmentation, DMZs, and firewalls
  - Implement cybersecurity controls based on IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, ISO 27001, and ISA 95 standards
  - Conduct risk assessments including threat modelling and vulnerability scanning
- System Integration & Compliance
  - Lead OT/IT convergence projects such as cloud OT, data historians, and MES implementations
  - Ensure GMP compliance including 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, and CSV requirements
  - Validate OT systems through IQ/OQ/PQ activities for computerized systems
- Project & Vendor Management
  - Estimate, plan, and implement OT projects including network upgrades and cybersecurity hardening projects
  - Manage external vendors such as cybersecurity auditors and system integrators
  - Manage OT budgets including Capex investments and OpEx maintenance activities
- Team Leadership & Standards
  - Mentor OT Engineers on best practices including secure coding and network design
  - Define OT standards related to password policies, patch management, and backup procedures
  - Lead incident response activities for OT cybersecurity events
- Innovation & Continuous Improvement
  - Monitor latest OT technologies such as Zero Trust, Edge Computing, and AI-driven anomaly detection
  - Support digital transformation projects including Industry 4.0 and Smart Manufacturing
  - Collaborate with IT teams on hybrid OT/IT solutions including cloud-based monitoring systems

## You ?

- Master's Degree in Operational Technology, Computer Science, or Cybersecurity
- 7+ years of experience in OT environments including industrial IT, networks, and cybersecurity
- 3+ years of experience in a leadership role such as OT Engineer or Cybersecurity Specialist
- Experience within GMP-regulated industries such as Pharmaceuticals, Food & Beverage, or Chemicals
- Knowledge of project management methodologies including Agile, ITIL, and COBIT
- Knowledge of OT systems including Windows/Linux servers, virtualization, and Industrial IoT (IIoT)
- Cybersecurity standards and technologies including IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, ISO 27001, Palo Alto and Fortinet firewalls, IDS/IPS, and SIEM platforms such as Splunk or IBM QRadar
- Industrial networking protocols including TCP/IP, Ethernet, Profinet/Profibus, OPC UA, Modbus, and DNP3
- Compliance frameworks including GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11 (EU GMP), and SOX
- Programming and scripting languages including Python, PowerShell, and SQL
- Computer System Validation (CSV) and Risk-Based Validation methodologies
- Tools such as Wireshark, Nessus, and SIEM platforms
- Risk-aware with a cybersecurity mindset
- A collaborative professional able to bridge OT and IT teams while working with EHS, Quality, and Production
- Experience in root-cause analysis and cyber incident investigations
- Fluent in English and French, with the ability to explain technical concepts and risks to non-technical partners

Due to its activities, Givaudan is subject to the regulations of the OFAC (Office Fédéral de l'Aviation Civile). Please note that later in the recruitment process we will ask you to provide a criminal record.

## Our Benefits:

Health InsuranceLife InsurancePaid time off and family leaveRetirement planSport and leisure clubsCompany shopStaff restaurantMobility allowance

This is a hybrid remote/in-office role. #LI-Hybrid

Every essence of you enriches our world. Givaudan is committed to equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications regardless of cultural and social background, gender, age, religion or sexual identity. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

You are a structured and collaborative compliance professional who combines regulatory expertise with strong project management capabilities. You are comfortable operating in complex, international environments and can translate technical requirements into practical business solutions. Your professional profile includes:Proven experience with complex project management skills and methodologiesAbility to work in a fast-paced environment, adapt to changing priorities with strong problem-solving skills and proactive approach to challengesExperience in compliance, regulatory affairs, or related functions within the chemical, food ingredients, life sciences, or similar industriesStrong understanding of chemical control legislation and compliance implementation principlesProven experience managing cross-functional or transformation projectsStrong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skillsAbility to influence stakeholders and communicate effectively across all organizational levelsAbility to work autonomously while collaborating within global teamsBusiness fluency in English and French Our benefits Healthcare supportPaid Time Off and family leaveRetirement planSport and leisure clubsCompany shopStaff restaurantCorporate Mobility Plan

jobs.title: Head of Procurement Ingredients
jobs.description:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness and humility, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions that make people look and feel good. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Dive into varied, flexible, and stimulating environments. Meet empowered professionals to partner with, befriend, and stretch your skills alongside. Every day, your energy, your creativity, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

## Head of Procurement Ingredients - Your future position?

You will require to establish a clear segment vision with focus on value creation and bottom line – aligned with the current strategy goals and targets. You will develop and implement category strategies to achieve sustainable reductions in spend aligned with Division strategies. Actively engage and represent Procurement with key segment stakeholders. You will also operate in close collaboration with Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial Organization, GBS and the respective business partners. Lead & develop CatMan teams.

**Location:**Vernier or Shanghai

**Reporting to:**Deputy Head of Procurement F&B

## In this exciting role, you will be responsible for:

## Alignment of Strategies

- Establish joint commitments with a clear focus on business impact & winning with customers
- Develop/validate the annual Procurement Plan and budget within the segment. Agree priorities, sourcing strategies and timelines with stakeholders
- Create a vision that consistently delivers value to the segment through our Procurement current strategy of Competitive Advantage, Resilient Supply Chain and Sustainability.
- Actively support the responsible sourcing, sourcing4good project and the Scope 3 reduction journey.

## Partnership

- Represent the segment Procurement Categories in business review meetings as appropriate. Ensure information flow between the related segment and the Procurement Category management organization to effectively deliver against business/functional strategies
- Participate in the Global S&OP for Ingredients and work closely with Global Procurement Management/Supply Chain Management /Pricing heads/Ingredients Manufacturing Management.
- Proactively communicate relevant decisions and market trends, and inform about potential RM issues
- Establish a stakeholder engagement plan
- Fosters strong relationships with key suppliers within the segment in alignment with the strategy

## Sourcing Strategy

- Drive the development and implementation of category strategies aligned with the global Procurement strategy
- Monitor achievements against business goals and periodically reassess the targets.
- Promote Market Intelligence

## Portfolio Management

- Negotiate contracts and manage vendor partnerships globally
- Identify opportunities for portfolio optimization and actively involve creation and manufacturing in development of optimization plans
- Own key supplier relationship, and lead key supplier conflict resolutions
- Ensure adequate contract cover for materials and supplier compliance to contracts
- Ensure vendor performance at target levels
- 20-50% travel required

## People Management

- Build and develop a global category management organization
- Lead & develop the Category Managers in your team – on sourcing strategy, priority setting and communication to relevant stakeholder and resource optimization
- Attract and train the necessary talent to build a distinctive organization
- Develop a strong succession plan and promote high potentials and address performance gaps

## Your professional profile includes:

- More than 10-15 years’ of experience in Procurement/Commercial and/or OPS organisations
- Experience in Operations Management and/or acting as a Chemist in a chemical plant is preferred.
- Experience in managing global teams from diverse backgrounds.
- Knowledge of F&F/FMCG/Chemical industry
- Specific and intense technical and market knowledge in the respective segment
- Knowledge in the Fragrance and Flavours, FMCG or Chemical industry
- Excellent negotiation and communication skills
- Cultural awareness and used to work with fast-changing requirements

## Our Benefits:

- Attractive package with benefits
- Excellent opportunities for progressive learning and development
- A creative team environment that will inspire you

*LI-Y

At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.

We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.

Everyone — regardless of race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion, or any personal circumstances — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we all love to be and grow.

Every essence of you enriches our world. Join us in making a difference together.
